headline: Profit climbs with a larger share base as EPS holds flat
summary_short: Columbia Banking System reported Q2 FY2026 net income of $208M, up 8.3% q/q and 36.5% y/y; diluted EPS was $0.73, up 10.6% q/q but flat y/y as weighted diluted shares outstanding rose 36.4% y/y to 286.5M.
summary_long: Net income rose to $208M, up 8.3% q/q and 36.5% y/y. Diluted EPS was $0.73, up 10.6% q/q but unchanged y/y, as weighted diluted shares outstanding grew 36.4% y/y to 286.5M (down 1.9% q/q). Total cash fell to $1.77B, down 15.7% q/q and 8.9% y/y. Shareholders' equity rose 41.4% y/y to $7.55B, though it slipped 1.5% q/q.
